# ASA Lab

> ASA Lab is a Russian-language educational STEM platform for schools. Its active project environments are 3D modelling, virtual electronics, chess and Russian draughts. Block programming, drawing and visual projects are in development.

Canonical website: https://asa-lab.ru/
Primary language: Russian (ru-RU)
Source repository: https://github.com/spikeal8-maker/asa-lab

## Key facts

- Audience: school students, teachers and authors of educational materials.
- Learning model: students create and investigate; teachers review the actual project, attempt, move, model or measurement behind the result.
- Safety: no advertising, no open child chat with strangers, role- and class-scoped access.
- Product principle: unsupported or unverified results are diagnosed explicitly instead of being presented as successful.
- Availability: 3D modelling, virtual electronics, chess and Russian draughts are active; block programming and drawing are not yet creatable.
- Brand spelling: ASA Lab. Russian alternate name: АСА Лаб.

## Crawler policy

Public product information may be indexed, summarized and cited with a link to the canonical page. ASA Lab does not grant permission through this file to use its content for model training. See https://asa-lab.ru/robots.txt for machine-readable crawler directives.
